description: Get historical OHLCV candlestick chart data for one or more stock symbols (comma-separated). A single symbol supports start/end absolute timestamps and returns one chart; multiple symbols return a batch of charts plus per-symbol errors (interval/range only, no start/end).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor`; omitted = first page

end.description: End date as Unix timestamp (seconds). Defaults to now when `start` is set.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = curated default set

limit.description: Maximum candles per page; omitted = curated default (25)

range.description: Time range: 1d|5d|1mo|3mo|6mo|1y|2y|5y|10y|ytd|max (default: 1mo). Ignored when `start` is set.

start.description: Start date as Unix timestamp (seconds). When provided, overrides `range`.

symbols.description: One or more comma-separated ticker symbols (e.g., "AAPL" or "AAPL,MSFT,GOOG")

name: get_chart
title: Price Chart (OHLCV)
